method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: B137 textual review closed on 48332d32 with independent blind Claude (claude-opus-5.5) and GPT (gpt-6.1-sol) reviews of d3c7394d; the confirmations of 2bc8e9b1 (Claude) and 48332d32 (both) were later turns of the same two reviewer agents, not fresh agents (see batch-137-closure). Bounded textual reviews, not native-speaker certification.
limits: Textual review only: no Kotlin, Android JVM, native, rendered-font, device or phone acceptance (no JDK on the continuation machine).
8 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools.
One KANJIDIC2 name-only reading can be drawn as a wrong option and is disclosed, not fixed: 唯 ゆ on the ユイ prompt in a Starter session that also borrows 油 or 輸.
4 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines (井戸, 但し, 吐き気, 風呂敷) are pre-existing and out of scope.

Under the batch rule, readings with no declaring word article are listed but not quizzed, including common ones such as 傷 ショウ, 哀 アイ, 吐 ト, 井 セイ, 仰 ギョウ and あお.ぐ, and 善 よ.い; nine cards quiz only on readings and six only kun readings.
火傷 やけど is a gikun reading in the pinned JMdict (1577310), so it does not support a 傷 reading.
Daijisen labels the ロ of 語呂 and 風呂 as 当て字; the pinned JMdict does not mark those spellings ateji and the Joyo table lists 風呂 under ロ, so ロ is quizzed under the rule.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

Claude's initial review once had two view calls in flight and was summarized after a context compaction for 丁 to 卸; its final message prefixes the report with a summary that says 12 cards where the report says ten.

The scope audits do not attribute reads made through shell loops or Python, so all three confirmations show cards as unread that their reports say were read; the author checked those claims against the session events. The GPT audits' flags are false positives (a Python ** operator and, in both GPT runs, a relative path to the run's own report).

GPT's reports cannot name the exact model (the runtime records gpt-6.1-sol); its confirmation did not verify the 42 and 10 published-card counts behind the OP decline, read meta_scan.py without running it and checked the four added Metadata ids directly.
'Only in つかえのよほろ' (丁) rests on the author's search of the pinned JMdict; Claude found no よほろ headword in WWWJDIC.

The Metadata-line rule (every word named on a card has its JMdict id listed) is the author's writing rule, not checked by lint; meta_scan.py found 19 such gaps in the 31 published cards of batches 134-136 (docs/n1-reviews/batch-137-closure/meta-scan-b134-b136.txt), left for a later sweep.
Fix 2 had two earlier local versions (0c7f25fe, fa9be05c) and a GPT confirmation packet was built for fix 1 and replaced before sending; none was reviewed or published.
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
